_comment: Apple's September 2026 lineup, 2026-09-20: iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, all on sale from 2026-09-18. No new SE this year (apple.com/apple-watch-se/ still redirects to the SE 3, already in the catalog) and no base iPhone 18 was announced. Every figure is Apple's own, read twice — from support.apple.com Tech Specs AND from the matching apple.com/.../specs/ page — and the two agreed exactly on all eleven. The iPhones cite the apple.com specs page like every other iPhone row; the watches cite support.apple.com like the Series 11 / SE 3 / Ultra 3 rows. Watches are CASE ONLY, NO BAND, which is what Apple publishes and what every other watch row stores. Same conventions as apple-watch-2026-09.json: the aluminium cellular case is again LIGHTER than the GPS one (39.5 g vs 38.6 g at 46mm), titanium ships with one published weight so its variant carries no GPS/Cellular split, and a finish or colour that moves the number by a gram or two is ONE row on the first-listed finish with the other figure kept in the quote (the Ultra 4 on natural, black 63.1 g; the new CERAMIC case on Pearl White, Night Blue 1.1-1.6 g heavier), because catalog:audit rightly flags a colour in a variant and the difference is below anything a pack weight notices. Apple sells the ceramic case as the 46mm and 42mm models even though the case itself stands 47mm and 43mm tall; the variant follows Apple's model size.

rows.name: iPhone 18 Pro Max
rows.quote: iPhone 18 Pro Max Weight: 8.78 ounces (249 grams)

rows.name: Watch Series 12
rows.quote: Weight — 46mm Aluminum, GPS: 39.5 grams (Apple Watch Series 12 Tech Specs).

rows.name: Watch Series 12
rows.quote: Weight — 46mm Aluminum, GPS + Cellular: 38.6 grams. Apple's aluminium cellular case is LIGHTER than the GPS one, the same way it was on Series 10 and Series 11 (Apple Watch Series 12 Tech Specs).

rows.name: Watch Series 12
rows.quote: Weight — 46mm Titanium: 44.9 grams. Apple publishes ONE weight for the titanium case, so the variant carries no GPS/Cellular split (Apple Watch Series 12 Tech Specs).

rows.quote: Weight (Pearl White ceramic): 51.3 grams; weight (Night Blue ceramic): 52.9 grams — the 46mm model's ceramic case, which stands 47mm tall (Apple Watch Series 12 Tech Specs). Stored as Pearl White.
